<br>

Full-stack software engineer, team lead and Flutter expert for over 6 years. I build scalable backend systems and high-performance cross-platform apps for mobile and desktop. Along the way I led engineering at an AI startup and directed an open-source team of 8 for 7 years.

Beirut is home and coffee is load-bearing.

### Open source

- [**plugin_kit**](https://pub.dev/packages/plugin_kit), pure Dart plugin runtime with lifecycle and events
- [**flutter_box_transform**](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_box_transform), resizable, draggable boxes with handles (co-maintained)
- [**hyper_effects**](https://pub.dev/packages/hyper_effects), scroll and pointer effects with minimal code
- [**flutter_operations**](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_operations), type-safe async operation state management
- [**hyper_logger**](https://pub.dev/packages/hyper_logger), structured, hierarchical logging for Dart
